title: Prove the virtual destructor
prompt: Implement `class Resource` with a public virtual destructor and `class HeavyResource : public Resource` that acquires a resource in its constructor and releases it in its destructor. A helper `int& leaked()` (free function, function-local static) must count live HeavyResource objects. The test proves deleting through `Resource*` runs the derived destructor.

tests.name: through-base
tests.hint: With a virtual destructor the derived part is destroyed through the base pointer — the leak counter returns to 0.
